stimuli.body:

• Sana occupies March 7.
• Kiran occupies an even-numbered position in the stated order.
• Exactly 2 occupied positions separate Tara and Pia in the stated order.
• Exactly 3 occupied positions separate Isha and Tara in the stated order.

questions.explanation: Answer: Both I and II follow. Only a few means some are and some are not. All B are C and no C is D excludes every B from D.

questions.stem:

Conclusions:
I. All cards are loans.
II. No files is a loans.
questions.explanation: Answer: Neither I nor II follows. A need not be contained in D. Some B are C and therefore D, contradicting II.

questions.stem:

Conclusions:
I. All cards are loans.
II. Some loans are files.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only II follows. The B–C overlap is inside D, proving II. No universal A–D relation is given.

questions.stem:

Conclusions:
I. Some cards are bonds.
II. Some files are loans.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only I follows. The stated A–B overlap lies in C. Since B is contained in C, no B can be D.

questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
digital rural credit = re ze mi
digital secure growth = su ni re
rural secure access = mi ka ni
credit growth access = ka ze su
digital rural access = ka re mi
What is the code for “rural”?
questions.explanation: Answer: mi. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: digital = re, rural = mi, credit = ze, secure = ni, growth = su, access = ka.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 24 km east, turns left and walks 12 km, then turns left and walks 15 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 15. Net displacement is 9 km east and 12 km north. By Pythagoras, √(9² + 12²) = 15 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 62 km east, turns left and walks 76 km, then turns left and walks 5 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 39 km east, turns left and walks 20 km, then turns left and walks 24 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 25. Net displacement is 15 km east and 20 km north. By Pythagoras, √(15² + 20²) = 25 km.

questions.stem: H is the mother of D. F is the daughter of D. C is the father of D. How is F related to C?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. C is a parent of D, and F is D’s daughter. Hence F is C’s grandchild.

questions.stem: D is the brother of G. G is the mother of E. A is the father of D and G. How is D related to E?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. D is the brother of E’s mother G. Therefore D is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: G is the only daughter of E. E is the father of G. B is the son of G. D is the sister of E. How is E related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. E is the father of G, and G is B’s mother. Thus E is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 44 candidates, a candidate is 15th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 27. New front rank = 15+3 = 18. Back rank = 44 − 18 + 1 = 27.

questions.stem: In a queue of 47 candidates, a candidate is 18th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 26. New front rank = 18+4 = 22. Back rank = 47 − 22 + 1 = 26.

questions.stem: Two articles are sold for ₹1800 each. One earns 25% profit and the other incurs 20% loss. Find the combined cost price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 3690. Recover each cost separately: 1800×100/125 + 1800×100/80. Equal selling prices do not imply equal costs.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 18 and 27 hours. An outlet empties it in 27 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank.
questions.explanation: Answer: 18. Net rate = 1/18 + 1/27 − 1/27 = 1/18. Take the reciprocal.

questions.stem: A boat covers 170 km in still water in 10 hours. If the stream flows at 5 km/h, how far (km) can it travel upstream in 5 hours?
questions.explanation: Answer: 60. Still-water speed = 17 km/h. Upstream speed = 17 − 5. Distance = speed × 5.

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 8:9. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 6 months. A receives ₹115200 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 180000. Profit ratio is 96:54. Each ratio unit = ₹1200. Total = 150 × 1200.

questions.stem: A sum of ₹18000 earns ₹8100 simple interest in 3 years. At the same annual rate, what would be the amount (₹) after 2 years with annual compounding?
questions.explanation: Answer: 23805. Rate = interest ×100/(principal ×3) = 15%. Compound amount = 18000 × (1 + 15/100)².

questions.stem: A container holds 90 litres of pure milk. 18 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 57.6. Each replacement retains 4/5 of the milk. Remaining milk = 90 × (4/5)².

questions.stem: The average weight of 17 people is 34 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 52. New total minus old total = (17+1)×(34+1) − 17×34 = 52.

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 9 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 27. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+9)/(x+9) = 3/2 gives x = 9. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: A 270 m train moving at 61.2 km/h overtakes a runner moving in the same direction at 14.4 km/h. Find the time (seconds, to two decimals) to pass the runner.
questions.explanation: Answer: 20.77. Relative speed = (61.2 − 14.4) ×5/18 = 13 m/s. Time = 270/13.

questions.stem: The price of a commodity increases by 25%. A household keeps spending fixed at ₹3200. By what percentage must consumption decrease? (Round to two decimals.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 20. New quantity / old quantity = 100/125. Reduction percentage = 25/125 ×100.
